name: prism
description: Turn raw notes, transcripts or documents into proofed content, then into on-brand PDFs, trifold brochures, PowerPoint decks, social posts, email headers, HTML emails and carousels, in any brand installed in its kit. Includes a quick mode for a finished document in one pass.

interface.longDescription: Drafts content from any raw material, stops for your proof, then builds on-brand PDFs, trifold brochures, PowerPoint decks, social images, email headers, HTML emails and carousels in the brand the piece names. Every number is checked against the approved words. Quick mode builds one document in a single pass.
defaultPrompt: Draft these notes into a case study
